name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
label: Quest
description: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills is a Horde courier task connecting the Forsaken research efforts in Silverpine Forest with their outpost in Tarren Mill.…
intro: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills is a Horde courier task connecting the Forsaken research efforts in Silverpine Forest with their outpost in Tarren Mill. Entrusted with sensitive notes from Apothecary Renferrel, the traveler journeys south into the disputed Hillsbrad Foothills to deliver vital biological research to Apothecary Lydon. This dispatch reflects the intense pressure Lady Sylvanas Windrunner places upon the Royal Apothecary Society to produce a weapon of mass devastation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague. We are working diligently and have made much progress. It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.
For that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The journey will be a long one.
Head south and stick to the roads. Follow the signs closely!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, most excellent. Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect. I am anxious to study his work.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
